key_insight: A hybrid TFT–N-BEATS model combines short-term dynamics with long-term patterns to forecast PV power across five horizons.
engineering_relevance: Multi-horizon PV forecasts can support grid stability, energy scheduling, and coordinated PV–battery–grid operation.
method: TFT learns short-term dependencies and dynamic feature importance.
N-BEATS decomposes longer-term trends and seasonality.
Adaptive attention fuses both branches for 30-minute, 2-hour, 6-hour, 12-hour, and 24-hour forecasts.
evidence_signal: On multi-year DKASC datasets, the abstract reports RMSE values of 42.35–52.29, a 35–40% reduction versus TFT, and MAPE below 5% across datasets.
watch_item: RMSE units and horizon-specific errors are not provided in the abstract, and generalization beyond DKASC remains unestablished.
paper_title: A Hybrid TFT-NBEATS Framework for Robust Multi-Horizon Photovoltaic Power Forecasting
